doc.title: Bruce Johnstone interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2013

title: Touring Australia and pay of about $60 a week
summary: The band toured northern Australia and the Outback; he played bebop on Sundays and earned about $60 a week.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: And we did tours of Northern Australia and the Outback. And it was great. So we got to see the country up on the Great Barrier Reef.
Making it, yeah. Pretty much. And plus I was playing bebop on Sundays.
Oh, nice. Do you remember what you were making, what your salary would have been at the time?
Oh, I think it was maybe about $60 a week, which at the time was pretty good. It was more than a lot of people were making, and I had a car and I had a nice apartment.
